source.text: A pin started from its steady state at a power that then stays constant does not change: the hottest cell is the closed-form steady centre temperature (film, cladding wall, gap, fuel), mesh 100/20.
source.check: Second method: the same series solved in Python for oracles/closed-form-table.json, and FEED's own steady start (an independent finite-volume solution on the mesh, src/core/transientFv.ts) reproduces it within the mesh bound; FEED's steady-start tests in tests/steadyInitialState.test.ts.

coverage.domain: synthetic pin, constant properties, convective boundary, started from its steady operating state at 20 kW/m and held there for 100 ms (mesh 100/20)
